# Wingham Heating & Cooling

> Wingham Heating & Cooling is a local HVAC company serving Wingham, Huron County, Ontario, offering furnace repair, AC repair, ductless mini-split installation, heat pump repair and installation, fireplace installation, thermostat repair, and duct cleaning to homeowners across the region.

Phone: (519) 357-0136  |  Email: contact@winghamheatingcooling.ca  |  Website: https://winghamheatingcooling.ca

Service areas: Wingham, Blyth, Belgrave, Brussels, Lucknow
